key_idea: Drive from the green dot and check every corner: each turn must be a left turn.
steps: Route A: the car starts at the green dot and drives right.
At the first corner it turns up. That is a left turn.
At the next corner it turns to drive left, to the red square. That is a left turn too.
Every other route has a right turn somewhere.

choice_feedback.B: The car drives right and then turns down. That is a right turn.
choice_feedback.C: The car drives up and then turns right at the corner.
choice_feedback.D: The first turn is left, but the second turn is a right turn.
choice_feedback.E: The car drives right and then turns down. That is a right turn.
